WITH telescope_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    observstation,
    COUNT(*) as telescope_count
  FROM telescopes
  GROUP BY observstation
),
stats AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(telescope_count) as total_count,
    COUNT(*) as num_observatories
  FROM telescope_counts
),
shares AS (
  SELECT 
    tc.observstation,
    tc.telescope_count,
    CAST(tc.telescope_count AS FLOAT) / s.total_count as share,
    1.0 / s.num_observatories as avg_share,
    (CAST(tc.telescope_count AS FLOAT) / s.total_count) - (1.0 / s.num_observatories) as gap_above_avg
  FROM telescope_counts tc, stats s
)
SELECT 
  observstation,
  telescope_count,
  share,
  gap_above_avg
FROM shares
WHERE share > avg_share
ORDER BY gap_above_avg DESC
LIMIT 10;
